entities.summary: Albert Vishnyakov is a Russian professional ice hockey forward. He currently plays for Metallurg Novokuznetsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Vishnyakov was drafted in the 9th round of the 2003 NHL Entry Draft by the Tampa Bay Lightning.
